title: CY60030: Inorganic Photochemistry
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Prerequisite : NilExcited states: excited states, decay, quantum yield, physico
chemical laws. Examples of photochemical reactions: photochemical reactions of
small molecules: NO, NO2, N2O, CO, O2, O3, SO2 etc.; mechanism and importance;
photo redox substitution, isomerization, prompt and delayed reaction, metal
bonded systems, solar energy conversion and storage, photo splitting of water
by photo galvanic method and semi conductor electrodes. Metal ion catalysis of
organic reactions: mechanisms and applications.
